tek bir söz bile duymayacaksınız,

entries.turkish: Halifax: Tamamen hayatınızdan çıkacağım!
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Ugh.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Of.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Alright, get the fuck outta here.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Tamam, siktir git buradan.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Halifax: Thank you! Thank you!
entries.turkish: Halifax: Teşekkürler! Teşekkürler!
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Jason: I hope that doesn't bite us in the ass.
Well...
entries.turkish:
Jason: Umarım bu iş sonra götümüzde patlamaz.
Neyse...
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: I'm gonna make sure this gets back safe.
entries.turkish: Jason: Bunu sağ salim geri götüreyim ben.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: You grab anything good.
entries.turkish: Jason: Sen de hoşuna giden ne varsa al.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Alright, cool.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Tamam, süper.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Lucia. I want to do you a favor.
entries.turkish: Randy: Lucia. Sana bir iyilik yapmak istiyorum.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Randy: Your days selling shitty sedans in the pay 'n' spray are
over!
entries.turkish:
Randy: Pay 'n' Spray'de boktan sedanlar sattığın günler
artık geride kaldı!
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: You are in the big leagues now. You ever drive a Zorrusso?
entries.turkish: Randy: Artık büyük oynuyorsun. Hiç Zorrusso sürdün mü?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: No.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Hayır.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Well, now is your chance.
entries.turkish: Randy: İşte fırsatın ayağına geldi.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: A welcome to Vice City gift, from me to you.
entries.turkish: Randy: Benden sana bir Vice City'ye hoş geldin hediyesi.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: And then from you to me.
entries.turkish: Randy: Sonra da senden bana.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Okay... So whose is it?
entries.turkish: Lucia: Tamam... Kimin arabası peki?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Bah-bah-bah. Details.
entries.turkish: Randy: Ba ba ba. Bunlar ayrıntı.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Randy: It's sitting in the parking lot of the Hathaway Apartments
in Ocean Beach.
entries.turkish:
Randy: Ocean Beach'teki Hathaway Apartmanları'nın
otoparkında duruyor.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: On Shore Drive and Seaview Boulevard.
entries.turkish: Randy: Shore Drive ile Seaview Bulvarı'nda.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Call me when you get there.
entries.turkish: Randy: Vardığında beni ara.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Alright.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Tamam.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Good! You have a key cloner, yeah?
entries.turkish: Randy: Güzel! Anahtar kopyalayıcın var, değil mi?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Key cloner? No...
entries.turkish: Lucia: Anahtar kopyalayıcı mı? Yok...
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: No? In your line of work? For the keyless cars!
entries.turkish: Randy: Yok mu? Senin yaptığın işte? Anahtarsız arabalar için!
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Randy: Okay, I will arrange this for you too,
because I am so good to you.
entries.turkish:
Randy: Tamam, onu da ayarlarım sana,
çünkü sana çok iyi davranıyorum.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: The Hathaway Apartments. Call me when you get there!
entries.turkish: Randy: Hathaway Apartmanları. Vardığında beni ara!
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Hey. Gonna grab that Zorrusso.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Selam. Şu Zorrusso'yu almaya geldim.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Randy: Perfect! Now, this is keyless car.
You never took one of these before, huh?
entries.turkish:
Randy: Harika! Bu anahtarsız bir araba.
Daha önce bunlardan çalmadın, değil mi?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Uh, not successfully...
entries.turkish: Lucia: Şey, başardığım olmadı...
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Randy: Well, first time for everything!
My guy is going to send you the key cloner now.
entries.turkish:
Randy: Her şeyin bir ilki vardır!
Benimki şimdi sana anahtar kopyalayıcıyı gönderecek.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Okay. And that'll start it?
entries.turkish: Lucia: Tamam. Onunla çalıştırabilecek miyim?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Yep. Easy.
entries.turkish: Randy: Evet. Kolay.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: The advanced tracker, not so easy.
entries.turkish: Randy: Gelişmiş takip cihazı o kadar kolay değil.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: It pings the cops, they put out an APB.
entries.turkish: Randy: Polise sinyal gönderiyor, onlar da arama emri çıkarıyor.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Okay. So... how do you disable it?
entries.turkish: Lucia: Tamam. Peki... Nasıl devre dışı bırakılıyor?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: You don't.
entries.turkish: Randy: Bırakılmıyor.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Just drive fast! Good luck.
entries.turkish: Randy: Gaza bas yeter! Bol şans.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Wow. That was too easy.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Vay. Fazla kolay oldu bu.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: In Russian: Eighteen...
entries.turkish: Randy: Rusça: On sekiz...
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: In Russian: twenty!
entries.turkish: Randy: Rusça: Yirmi!
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Not bad! That's a nice car, eh?
entries.turkish: Randy: Fena değil! Güzel araba, değil mi?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Nice for you. For me, one night at NINE1NINE.
entries.turkish: Randy: Sana göre güzel. Bana göre NINE1NINE'da bir gecelik masraf.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: You know, most small time guys they get a car like this,
entries.turkish: Randy: Bilirsin, ufak çaplı elemanlar böyle bir araba bulunca,
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: first thing they do is wrap it around a streetlight.
entries.turkish: Randy: ilk iş gidip bir sokak lambasına sararlar.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Looks like that's exactly what you did.
entries.turkish: Randy: Görünüşe bakılırsa sen de aynısını yapmışsın.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: I got it here, didn't I?
entries.turkish: Lucia: Buraya getirdim, değil mi?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Okay, let's go. Time to see the board.
entries.turkish: Randy: Tamam, hadi. Panoya bakma zamanı.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Randy: The Zorrusso! Done. Say goodbye. Next time you see it,
it will be on some Saudi prince's Snapmatic page.
entries.turkish:
Randy: Zorrusso! Tamamdır. Elveda de. Bir dahaki görüşünde,
Suudi prensinin tekinin Snapmatic sayfasında olacak.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: These other cars... All for the same guy.
entries.turkish: Randy: Şu diğer arabalar... Hepsi aynı adam için.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Big buyer. Big balls. Not so interested in paperwork.
entries.turkish: Randy: Büyük alıcı. Taşaklı adam. Evrak işleriyle pek ilgilenmiyor.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Randy: So... how big are your balls?
Are you gonna get me more names to cross off?
entries.turkish:
Randy: Peki... Sen ne kadar taşaklısın?
Listeden sileceğim başka isimler getirecek misin bana?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Sure, I can keep an eye out.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Tabii, gözümü dört açarım.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Good. This guy, he is not patient.
entries.turkish: Randy: Güzel. Bu adam pek sabırlı değildir.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: He takes apologies in fingers. That's not a problem for me.
entries.turkish: Randy: Özür yerine parmak kabul eder. Benim için sorun değil.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: But for you, maybe work fast.
entries.turkish: Randy: Ama senin yerinde olsam hızlı davranırdım.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Randy: You need any info, you talk to me. I know everything,
and everybody.
entries.turkish:
Randy: Bilgi lazım olursa bana gel. Her şeyi bilirim,
herkesi tanırım.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Randy: Bye-bye then.
entries.turkish: Randy: Hadi, güle güle.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: It's a big place.
entries.turkish: Jason: Büyük yermiş.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Uh-huh.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Hı hı.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Act natural and blend in.
entries.turkish: Raul: Doğal davranın, dikkat çekmeyin.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Stand by a table, fill out a form or some shit.
entries.turkish: Raul: Bir masaya geçip form falan doldurun işte.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: Right here, c'mon.
entries.turkish: Jason: Burada, gel.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Lucia: Where you at? You here too or...
are we on our own for this?
entries.turkish:
Lucia: Neredesin? Sen de burada mısın, yoksa...
bu işte yalnız mıyız?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Raul: Slow down, mamita. It's not like that.
We're here for a meeting.
entries.turkish:
Raul: Sakin ol, mamita. Öyle bir şey yok.
Bir görüşme için buradayız.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: We got a couple of minutes.
entries.turkish: Raul: Birkaç dakikamız var.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Raul: Take a look around, tell me what you see.
Don't start any shit.
entries.turkish:
Raul: Etrafınıza bakıp ne gördüğünüzü söyleyin.
Olay çıkarmayın.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Cameras, a lot of 'em.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Kamera, bir sürü.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Yeah, those are just the ones you can see.
entries.turkish: Raul: Evet, onlar sadece görebildikleriniz.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Raul: Karim counted a hundred and five points of coverage,
just on this floor.
entries.turkish:
Raul: Karim sadece bu katta yüz beş ayrı noktadan
görüntü alındığını saydı.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: One hundred and five? Shit.
entries.turkish: Jason: Yüz beş mi? Siktir.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: We're working on a full override.
entries.turkish: Raul: Sistemi tamamen ele geçirmek için çalışıyoruz.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Trust me,
entries.turkish: Raul: İnanın bana,
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: you don't want these guys having a home movie of you.
entries.turkish: Raul: bu adamların eline filminizin geçmesini istemezsiniz.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Got to be more than that.
entries.turkish: Raul: Daha fazlası olmalı.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: I see an undercover. He's packing.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Bir sivil görüyorum. Silahlı.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Eyeballing everyone like he owns the place.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Buranın sahibiymiş gibi herkesi süzüyor.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Okay, what else?
entries.turkish: Raul: Tamam, başka?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.turkish: Lucia: Korumalar işi biliyor gibi. Asker falan sanki.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: Pretty heavy.
entries.turkish: Jason: Ağır abiler.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: What more you see?
entries.turkish: Raul: Başka ne görüyorsunuz?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: Okay. Line of tellers.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Şey, sıra sıra vezne.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: Big place like this, those drawers gotta be stacked, huh?
entries.turkish: Jason: Böyle büyük yerde o çekmeceler dolup taşıyordur, ha?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Drawers are good, but that's not why we're here.
entries.turkish: Raul: Çekmeceler iyi hoş da biz onun için burada değiliz.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.turkish: Lucia: Kasayı mı istiyorsun?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Mm-hmm.
entries.turkish: Raul: Hı hı.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.turkish: Raul: Tamam, bitiyor. Neyi gözden kaçırıyorsunuz?

entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: But we gotta get past it. It's our only way to the vault floor.
entries.turkish: Raul: Ama onu aşmalıyız. Kasanın olduğu kata tek geçişimiz o.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: We can't blow it?
entries.turkish: Jason: Patlatsak olmaz mı?
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Raul: Not without setting off the alarm and we don't want no
fuckin'cops.
entries.turkish:
Raul: Alarmı çalıştırmadan olmaz. Polisleri de
tepemizde istemiyoruz.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Good, good, that's enough.
entries.turkish: Raul: Güzel, güzel. Bu kadar yeter.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: So, it's not your momma's bank, huh?
entries.turkish: Jason: Yani burası bildiğimiz bankalardan değil, ha?

Jason: So, it's not your momma's bank, huh?

Jason: Yani burası bildiğimiz bankalardan değil, ha?

entries.turkish: Raul: Fark ettiğiniz o siviller mi? Tetikçiler.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.turkish: Raul: Burası kartel bankası. Sahibi de işleteni de Polilla Negra.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Jason: Figures.
entries.turkish: Jason: Şaşırmadım.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: This is what it's been all about. C'mon, over here, look up.
entries.turkish: Raul: Bütün mesele buydu işte. Gelin, şu tarafa, yukarı bakın.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Hola. C'mon, meeting's upstairs. I don't wanna be late.
entries.turkish: Raul: Hola. Hadi, görüşme yukarıda. Geç kalmak istemiyorum.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: I told you. I knew he was pulling something.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Demiştim sana. Bir şeyler çevirdiğini biliyordum.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Lucia: I got a nose for this shit.
entries.turkish: Lucia: Böyle şeylerin kokusunu alırım ben.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english:
Raul: Yeah, you've been helping us lay the ground work,
rattling the cage,
entries.turkish:
Raul: Evet, zemini hazırlamamıza yardım ettiniz,
adamları huzursuz ettiniz,

entries.english:
Raul: letting them know their money's not safe nowhere in the
city.
entries.turkish:
Raul: paralarının şehrin hiçbir yerinde
güvende olmadığını gösterdiniz.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

Raul: We knew they'd have to pull the plug and move it all here

Raul: Eninde sonunda pes edip bütün parayı buraya
taşımak zorunda kalacaklarını biliyorduk.

Raul: They're dumping every last dime they got into the vault
downstairs.

Raul: Son kuruşlarına kadar her şeyi
aşağıdaki kasaya yığıyorlar.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: Beautiful.
entries.turkish: Raul: Harika.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.turkish: Andrea: Oturun... Doğal davranın.

entries.turkish: Raul: Tamam, dinleyin.
entries.source_review: Native source crop visually checked; OCR corrected.

entries.english: Raul: We're here to see Nicole Park...
entries.turkish: Raul: Nicole Park'la görüşmeye geldik...

entries.english:
Raul: Security expert for the cartel,
and designer for the vault downstairs.

entries.english: Raul: When we come out, we'll go one way, she'll go another.

entries.english:
Raul: You just do what you gotta do,
and get her back to the lock up.
entries.turkish:
Raul: Siz de ne gerekiyorsa yapıp
onu depoya getireceksiniz.
